name: Astral Fatigue
description: Pressure surges unnaturally. Each stack intensifies internal strain building up to cap of 15 stacks where it bursts, striking nearby enemies with a retaliatory shockwave that applies stun, fear, immobilize, expose while ignoring dodge, and damage equal to the they suffered in the last 5 hits (ignores harming party members).

name: Frostburn
description: The cold of the astral gets harsher the more it stacks up
